about_the_game:
🐾 Welcome to Animal Survival!

Experience a fast-paced, 3D casual roguelike RPG where the wild comes to life. Master the art of survival as you evolve your animal, craft powerful gear.

🎯 How to Play

  • Survive the Clock: Hold your ground until the timer hits zero to clear the map.

  • Evolve & Gear Up: Defeat enemies to gather materials, level up, and craft superior equipment.

  • Expand Your Territory: Unlock new biomes and collect coins to permanently increase your strength.

🗺️ Explore & Conquer

  • Diverse Maps: Journey through lush forests and harsh savannas, each with unique challenges.

  • Deep Progression: Use gathered resources to upgrade your character and unlock powerful new abilities.

  • Dynamic Crafting: Turn your fallen foes into the tools you need to survive the next wave.

⚔️ Competitive 1v1 PvP

Step into the arena! Test your skills in high-stakes 1v1 duels. Track your rivals using the mini-map, manage your respawns, and out-hunt the competition. In this mode, every animal defeated counts toward your victory—highest score takes the crown.

🏆 Global Leaderboard

Do you have what it takes to be the Alpha? Compete against the world’s best survivors. Your progress is tracked across:

  • Total Maps Cleared

  • Highest Animal Levels Reached

  • PvP Tokens Earned

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+
  • Processor: Intel i3 (4th gen) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel i3 (4th gen) or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
